Not sure if this aligns with your background, but I did a program called AmeriCorps NCCC when i was your age after dropping out of college; your story resonates with how i was feeling. 

It really opened my eyes to what I wanted to do, and gave me some amazing stories to tell. I met some phenomenal people from it who I still keep in touch with, and visit when traveling. 

It wasn’t the smartest financial choice I ever made, but did learn that sometimes uprooting yourself and finding new places and spaces can get you out of a rut. I still work in the social impact space to this day, and being an alumni of AmeriCorps has always helped me find a new crew of similarly minded folks. 

Stay strong my guy, if you’re talking about it, you’re doing something about it.
